signals.summary: Second round of 2026 layoffs affecting about 500 workers, roughly 2.5% of workforce, mainly product and technology.
Earlier 2026 layoff round cut about 400 employees in February.
CEO change: Carl Eschenbach departed and cofounder Aneel Bhusri returned as chief executive.
Workday has been GAAP profitable in recent years with strong cash position and little debt.
Company says it will keep hiring in strategic areas and locations through fiscal 2027.
